description: Sixteen-place shift register for gates or control voltage, moving every stored value on one place with each shift pulse and taking a new value in

params.text: Turns recirculation on, so the value leaving the far end of the register is fed back to the other end instead of being lost
Picks what happens to the recirculated value: LOCK passes it round untouched, MIN/AND, MAX/OR and AVG/XOR combine it with the value at IN, and INVERT flips it
Chooses whether stored values move towards output 16, with new values entering at output 1, or back towards output 1, with new values entering at output 16
Sets how likely the chosen loop operation is on any shift pulse, 0% to 100%; with a cable in the chance CV input it attenuates that voltage

inputs.text: The value taken into the register on each shift pulse; with nothing patched an internal random generator supplies it instead
A rising edge shifts every stored value on by one place and takes a new value from IN
A high gate turns recirculation on and a low gate turns it off, taking the LOOP ENABLE switch out of circuit
A high gate shifts values back towards output 1 and a low gate shifts them towards output 16, taking the REVERSE switch out of circuit
Picks the loop operation by voltage and takes the LOOP MODE switch out of circuit: under 1V LOCK, 1V to 2V MIN/AND, 2V to 3V MAX/OR, 3V to 4V AVG/XOR, 4V and over INVERT
0-10V setting how likely the chosen loop operation is on any shift pulse, scaled by the CHANCE knob

outputs.text: Carries the value stored in that place of the register
Carries the internal random value drawn at the last shift pulse, whether or not a cable is patched into IN

menu: Digital mode — squares the input to a gate and makes every output 0V or 10V; with it off the register carries control voltage unchanged, and switching between the two clears the register
Internal random range — sets the values the internal generator draws to 0V to 10V, -10V to 10V, 0V to 5V or -5V to 5V; the entry is there only while Digital mode is off

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
